exercises.instructions: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom.

questions.question: What does 'a piece of cake' mean?
questions.explanation: 'A piece of cake' means something very easy to do. 'a piece of cake' ဆိုတာ အလွယ်တကူလုပ်နိုင်တဲ့ အရာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'black sheep' mean?
options: a person who is considered a disgrace or failure by their family
questions.answer: a person who is considered a disgrace or failure by their family
questions.explanation: 'Black sheep' refers to a person who is considered a disgrace or failure by their family or group. 'black sheep' ဆိုတာ မိသားစုရဲ့ စိတ်နှောင့်ရှက်ဖွယ်လူကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'all smiles' mean?
questions.explanation: 'All smiles' means very happy and smiling. 'all smiles' ဆိုတာ ပျော်ပျော်ပန်းပန်း ရှိနေတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'break the ice' mean?
options: to initiate a conversation or ease tension
questions.answer: to initiate a conversation or ease tension
questions.explanation: 'Break the ice' means to initiate a conversation or ease tension in a social situation. 'break the ice' ဆိုတာ ပထမဆုံးတွေ့တဲ့အခါ စကားစပြပြီး ရင်းနှီးအောင်လုပ်တာပါ။

questions.question: What does 'foot the bill' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Foot the bill' means to pay for something; to cover the cost. 'foot the bill' ဆိုတာ ကုန်ကျစရိတ်ကို ပေးဆောင်တာပါ။

questions.question: What does 'over the moon' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Over the moon' means extremely happy and delighted about something. 'over the moon' ဆိုတာ အလွန်ပျော်ရွှင်နေတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'crocodile tears' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Crocodile tears' means fake or insincere tears; pretending to be sad. 'crocodile tears' ဆိုတာ ဟန်ဆောင်ပြီးငိုတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'get a grip' mean?
options: to control oneself or a situation
questions.answer: to control oneself or a situation
questions.explanation: 'Get a grip' means to control oneself or a situation; to calm down. 'get a grip' ဆိုတာ ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကို ထိန်းချုပ်တာပါ။

questions.question: What does 'go through the roof' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Go through the roof' means to become extremely angry or furious. 'go through the roof' ဆိုတာ အလွန်ဒေါသထွက်တာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'pie in the sky' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Pie in the sky' means an unrealistic or impossible hope or plan. 'pie in the sky' ဆိုတာ မဖြစ်နိုင်တဲ့ မျှော်လင့်ချက်ကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'once in a blue moon' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Once in a blue moon' means very rarely; almost never. 'once in a blue moon' ဆိုတာ အလွန်ရှားရှားဖြစ်ဖြစ် ဖြစ်တာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'out of the blue' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Out of the blue' means unexpectedly; without warning; completely surprising. 'out of the blue' ဆိုတာ မမျှော်လင့်ဘဲ ဖြစ်လာတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'get rid of' mean?
options: to remove or throw away something unwanted
questions.answer: to remove or throw away something unwanted
questions.explanation: 'Get rid of' means to remove, throw away, or eliminate something unwanted. 'get rid of' ဆိုတာ မလိုချင်တဲ့အရာကို ဖယ်ရှားပစ်တာပါ။

questions.question: What does 'off colour' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Off colour' means feeling unwell, slightly ill, or not in one's usual good health. 'off colour' ဆိုတာ နမကောင်းဖြစ်နေတာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'on the spot' mean?
questions.explanation: 'On the spot' means immediately; right away; at that very moment. 'on the spot' ဆိုတာ ချက်ချင်း၊ ချိန်ချိန်ဆဆ ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'leave it at that' mean?
options: to stop talking about something or accept the current situation
questions.answer: to stop talking about something or accept the current situation
questions.explanation: 'Leave it at that' means to stop talking about something; to accept the current situation. 'leave it at that' ဆိုတာ ဒီလောက်ပဲထားလိုက်ကြပါလို့ ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'walk of life' mean?
options: a person's occupation, status, or social class
questions.answer: a person's occupation, status, or social class
questions.explanation: 'Walk of life' refers to a person's occupation, status, or social class. 'walk of life' ဆိုတာ လူတစ်ယောက်ရဲ့ အလုပ်၊ လူမှုအဆင့်အတန်းကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။

questions.question: What does 'a penny for your thoughts' mean?
options: an offer to buy something cheap
a way to ask someone what they are thinking
questions.answer: a way to ask someone what they are thinking
questions.explanation: 'A penny for your thoughts' is a gentle way to ask someone what they are thinking about. 'a penny for your thoughts' ဆိုတာ တစ်ယောက်ယောက် ဘာတွေတွေးနေလဲ မေးတဲ့ နည်းလမ်းပါ။

questions.question: What does 'not at all' mean?
options: a polite response to thanks; not in any way
questions.answer: a polite response to thanks; not in any way
questions.explanation: 'Not at all' is a polite response to thanks, meaning 'you're welcome'; also means 'not in any way'. 'not at all' ဆိုတာ ကျေးဇူးတင်တဲ့အခါ ပြန်ဖြေတဲ့ ယဉ်ကျေးတဲ့ စကားပါ။

questions.question: What does 'child's play' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Child's play' means something very easy to do. 'a piece of cake' has the same meaning. 'child's play' ဆိုတာ အလွန်လွယ်ကူတဲ့ အရာကို ဆိုလိုပါတယ်။
